description: CapMeta smoke-test greeting (no Linode API call). The greeting comes from the contract's success_message template, so the cases pin the template's halves: the default the empty call falls back to, the name a caller supplies, and the default a name the contract cannot hold falls back to instead of being rendered as itself.

expect_result.message: Hello, World! LinodeMCP server is running and ready.

cases.name: greets the name the call supplied

expect_result.message: Hello, Ada! LinodeMCP server is running and ready.

cases.name: greets the default name when the name is not a string

expect_result.message: Hello, World! LinodeMCP server is running and ready.

cases.name: refuses an argument the message does not declare
